caveats: the model authored the one tool call that ran the verifier: entry 5 of the exported pilot session transcript (off-repo, source below) is an assistant message from gpt-6-luna whose single workspace_exec call appends the tests and ends with rustc --edition=2024 --test /acceptance.rs -o /tmp/check && /tmp/check; entry 4 is the prompt that instructs it to run the original independent validator (pass 2 section 1; entries counted from 0 and read by the repair builder). No read of the verifier's text is recorded, and with one call the model could not iterate against its output
the smoke-plus-private-verifier pattern has never run with a live model (the Sol/high round stopped at admission with zero model requests)
no remediation found in the repository by grep (pass 1; unverified beyond that)
the pilot's task acceptance was not overturned: it also rested on the crate suite, mutation checks and separate review
pass 1 searched all 21 files of the pilot bundle for visibility or independence language; hits were mount and command strings only; not repeated by the register builder
findings.claim: The current Host mounts profile.acceptance at /acceptance.rs in both the tool and validation containers; in the accepted local development pilot the authoritative validator (sha256 c3e91c48...) was readable in the tool container, named in the model's tool description and prompt, and run by the model's one tool call.
